subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is “**Leftinant**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The incorrectly spelled word among the options provided is **“Leftenan**t”. The** correct** spelling is** “Lieutenant”**. This spelling discrepancy arises because “Leftenant” is a common misinterpretation or mispronunciation, especially considering the British English pronunciation of "lieutenant", which sounds like "lef-tenant". 
 
• The correct spellings for the other options are as follows: “Longevity” (referring to a long duration of life or existence), “Ludicrous” (meaning something is so foolish, unreasonable, or out of place that it becomes amusing), and “Location” (referring to a particular place or position). These spellings are standard and widely accepted in English dictionaries.

Hence, the correct answer is ‘**Option 2**’
